title: Launcher slice two: the launch pill stays after Publish as Finish setup over the Get Started list

source.ref: Owner direction 2026-10-29: an always-present reminder button to finish setup

detail: The header launch pill used to vanish on Publish. It now stays as 'Finish setup' with the Get Started count and a sheet of what is left (lib/launch/setup-box.ts over the one list in lib/launch/get-started.ts), until every item is done. Hide with two confirmations and the restore in Settings are slice three; the Setup registry from SPACE_MODULES is slice four.

verify.evidence: The box loader builds the Finish setup box after Publish and the pill has its face.
